Aisha (CS): Quick heads-up — Silversail's canary showed a 12% tail latency spike during RPS bursts this morning. p95 ~220ms but tail up to ~980ms on a few shards.
Ravi (SE): :eyes: thanks for flagging. Any recent model or config changes before the spike?
Aisha (CS): They swapped to compact-int8 yesterday for a cost test and token-per-request increased ~30%. No obvious errors in logs.
Lucas (ML): int8 + longer sequences often increases KV cache pressure. Could be cache eviction thrash or precision mismatch on KV.
Ravi (SE): Agreed. Quick triage plan: 1) enable prefix KV caching, 2) loosen batching tolerance slightly, 3) canary ~5% traffic back to fp16 baseline if tails persist.
Aisha (CS): Can we draft a concise config snippet for Silversail so they can action quickly?
Ravi (SE): Suggested snippet to try (small changes only):
```
model: redwood/compact-int8-v3
routing:
  prefer_warm_nodes: true
  fallback: redwood/fp16-latency-opt
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 20
  max_tokens_in_batch: 2048
cache:
  prefix_kv_enabled: true
  max_prefix_entries: 5000
```
Lucas (ML): + recommendation: run a 5% fp16 canary for 15 minutes and collect 2x p95 windows (pre/post). Also capture a few sample outputs for regression checks.
Aisha (CS): Draft message to Silversail: "Can you canary 5% → fp16 for 15m and enable prefix_kv? We'll monitor p95 and tail behavior and report back." Sound good?
Ravi (SE): Yep. I'll schedule the 5% canary at 11:40 PT and attach the routing override.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by @Ravi (SE) for silversail-prod routing override (job 8921).
Aisha (CS): Thanks — if p95 improves >30% we recommend permanent routing change (fp16 for long-tail paths) while keeping int8 for low-token, high-throughput routes.
Lucas (ML): Also log a small evaluation set to check for quantization artifacts — better to be safe.
Aisha (CS): Great. I'll update Silversail and log these action items in the onboarding tracker. Will post results after the canary. :thumbsup:
